title: Python: E1 Cls(...).m() call on a constructed instance (DEC-303 (a22) item 3, (a23) step 4)
description: Admitted group E1: a method called on a directly constructed instance, Cls(...).m(), resolves to Cls.m through the MRO. Keeps the __new__ and metaclass checks (a class with a __new__ in its MRO or a non-default metaclass stays unresolved). Fixtures red before, green after, negative controls that reach the new branch. Held-out samples stay spent; python-gate fenced; Q2 and Q3 stay out.
implementationNotes: E1 built (DEC-303 (a22) item 3), 2026-11-26T01:23Z: calls.ts describeCallee gives a call receiver whose callee is a plain or dotted name the base kind 'constructed'; resolveConstructedCall resolves it through resolveCalleeToSymbol (the same binding enumeration as a bare call: one binding, any rebinding kind gives multiply or unresolved), requires a class with an ok MRO, no __new__ anywhere in the MRO (firstMethodEntry) and no effective metaclass (effectiveMetaclass), one segment only (Cls().a.m() stays unresolved), then methodLookup(polymorphicCheck true). Fixtures (test/python-calls.test.ts, 'E1'): baseline positive reaches the branch; imported, dotted-module and inherited positives; inside a function; 13 second-binding kinds (def, class, assign, annotated, AugAssign, walrus, for, with, except-as, import, conditional, try, global in a nested function) each unresolved; __new__ own and inherited; metaclass own and inherited; metaclass=type resolves, shadowed type does not; inconsistent MRO, longer chain, function callee, unbound callee; external base lands external-base. Red before: 7 failing tests without the src change (the negatives are green both ways and are paired with the baseline positive that proves the branch is reached). DEL: a first draft recorded 'del name' as a rebinding; the per-site measurement caught it (tqdm tests/tests_synchronisation.py:93-96, local monitor = TMonitor(...) used before 'del monitor' lost four edges). Reverted: a deleted name can only fail afterwards (NameError/UnboundLocalError), never read a different object, so del is not a second binding; a fixture pins that del after the call still resolves. One pinned bins fixture changed legitimately ('classes, inheritance and constructions': A().m() now resolves, 3/1 -> 4/0 in repo/receiver). PER-SITE RE-MEASURE, instrumented scratch worktrees at origin/dev 268d6ef vs the branch code, bin/reason/edge flags per call, multiset diff, all five pins with markerDirsFor (analyzeRepository): entry counts equal (3961, 6159, 4189, 9844, 3107). flask: 2 changed (1 receiver to inRepo tests/test_blueprints.py:217:10 flask.Flask(__name__).test_request_context; 1 receiver to external external-base src/flask/debughelpers.py:98:23 DebugFilesKeyError(...).with_traceback, a KeyError subclass); bins inRepo 1067 to 1068, external 1125 to 1126, receiver 1596 to 1594. jinja: 4 receiver to inRepo (src/jinja2/environment.py:621:16 Parser(...).parse, examples/basic/test_loop_filter.py:3:8, tests/test_api.py:391:13 gained the polymorphic flag on Environment.getattr, tests/test_inheritance.py:368:16); inRepo 2126 to 2130, receiver 2290 to 2286; polymorphicCount 171 to 172 (that one flagged site is in tests, hasSubclassOverride on Environment, SandboxedEnvironment). httpx: 5 receiver to inRepo (httpx/_auth.py:221:13, httpx/_models.py:404:13, tests/models/test_url.py:859:11, tests/test_asgi.py:107:15 and :118:15); inRepo 1733 to 1738, receiver 1020 to 1015. rich: 47 receiver to inRepo (7 in rich/ package, 10 benchmarks, the rest tests); inRepo 5515 to 5562, receiver 1521 to 1474. tqdm: 0 changed sites. Totals: 62 changed entries, 61 receiver to inRepo and 1 receiver to external; 11 of 62 are in package source (flask 1 external, jinja 1, httpx 2, rich 7); polymorphic flag gained on 1 site, multiplyBoundCount unchanged on all five (3, 5, 0, 25, 2); externalBaseBefore flag set on no new inRepo edge. I hand-read the package sites and the flask/jinja/httpx/rich examples; all are the Cls(...).m() shape. NOT MEASURED: precision of the 62 new edges against runtime or a labelled sample (the held-out samples are spent and the python-gate is fenced); I did not label them one by one beyond reading the first lines; a class decorator that replaces the class (not dataclass-like) is not checked, as for x = Cls() and bare Cls() constructions today; E1 in-package value on a fresh sample is unmeasured. Measurement scratch: worktrees and setup.ts under the session scratchpad, not committed.

ROUND 1 FIXES (Opus review of 9e5ace7: BLOCK on one test). (1) Added the negative C().m.x() (first segment a real method); mutation run: with the 'segments.length !== 1' guard deleted that test goes red (the only failure), restored and green. (2) The method-body case added to the positive test; title now true. (3) CORRECTION to the DEL wording in the earlier note: 'a deleted name can only fail afterwards, never read a different object' is false in general: a module-scope del of a name that is also a builtin falls back to the builtin, and a class-body del falls back to the global. Accurate statement: del adds no value to the name; a later read fails or falls back to an outer binding that this analysis does not model; del is therefore not recorded as a second binding (recording it cost four tqdm edges, tests/tests_synchronisation.py:93-96, for a fallback shape no measured site has). Test comment corrected the same way. Routed to opum-doc by the leader and held out of this PR: polymorphic flag on E1, opaque bases hiding __new__/metaclass, Outer.Inner().m() without a class-scope rebinding check.
